name: Whiteman AFB
description: Home of the 509th Bomb Wing. Whiteman AFB is the only operational B-2 Spirit stealth bomber base, providing global strike capability.

events.title: Skillbridge Briefing
events.description: This briefing is the first step for Airmen who are interested in participating in the DoD SkillBridge program. The program provides eligible transitioning DAF members opportunities to develop career skills through civilian on-the-job-training, employment skills training, apprenticeships, and internships to help them prepare for their transition from military to civilian employment.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Whiteman Inn (660-687-1844) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (660-687-5662) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 509 FSS, M&FRC, and official Whiteman sites for in-processing and B-2 mission support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
